reason: The same-URL comparison, exact quotes, old evidence, and Q1/Q2 locators are sound. The proposed no_substantive_update nevertheless leaves a material false impression in the retained source and concept: source line 20 and wiki/concepts/disputes.md line 41 state business loss plus dispute fee unconditionally, while old raw line 30 and new raw line 31 condition the loss on the dispute being resolved for the cardholder. The receipt notices this conflict but Q2 says the dated summary can remain as is. A reader asking whether every stolen-card dispute makes the business bear the payment amount would get a misleading answer without consulting raw.
